verdict.rationale: Open-source availability is a fair question for a speech-to-text API vendor, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers hosted APIs, self-hosting, SDKs and deployment options, but nothing shows the product's source is published under an open license. Mentions of SDKs and on-prem hosting are adjacent features, not open-source code.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
